sentences.text: He is running his business for more than ten years.
He has also made an application for issuance of Street Vending Certificate on 23rd February, 2025 in Form-II under Paragraph-6(2) the Scheme framed under the provisions of the Act.
The said application is pending before the Town Vending Committee, BMC-Opposite Party No.3.
When the matter stood thus, the BMC is contemplating his eviction along with other similarly placed vendors.
This Court in several other matters entertaining the writ petition, directed the Town Vending Committee, BMC to take a decision on the application for grant/renewal of certificate of Street Vending.

Hence, Mr. Das,
learned counsel submits that the case of the Petitioner may be considered by the Town Vending Committee, BMC and till it is considered, his possession over the space be protected to save him from penury.
4. Mr. Panda, learned counsel for BMC vehemently objects to the same.
It is his submission that the Petitioner was never issued with any certificate of Street Vending under the provisions of the Act.
He further submits that due to unauthorized occupation of the Petitioner and some other similarly placed vendors, there is traffic congestion and BMC is facing difficulty in sanitation work.

Further,
the nature of business is not coming under the provisions of the Act, Rules Designation: Senior Stenographer Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Date: 25-Apr-2025 13:01:26 and Scheme framed thereunder.
Thus, the Petitioner being an unauthorized occupant of a space meant for developmental purpose should be evicted immediately.

5. Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, this Court without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case of the parties, disposes of the writ petition with a direction to the Town Vending Committee, BMC-Opposite Party No.3 to consider and dispose of the application filed by the Petitioner for grant of certificate of Street Vending as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of one month from the date of production of certified copy of this order.

The Petitioner undertakes to produce the certified copy of this order within a period of ten days hence before the Town Vending Committee, BMC-Opposite Party No.3.
6.

Till a decision is taken on the application filed by the Petitioner for grant of certificate of Street Vending, no coercive measure shall be taken for eviction of the Petitioner from the place where he is running his business.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
